title: Kimi K2 Thinking and Gemini 3 Pro join the model garden
summary:
New reasoning and pro models arrived while the model catalog and usage calculations got a needed alignment pass.

Two more text models are now available through the unified endpoint: Kimi K2 Thinking for deliberate reasoning and Gemini 3 Pro for another capable general-purpose option. More choices, same HTTP call.

Model endpoints now expose their modelId directly, while model IDs and tests were updated to keep the catalog aligned with what actually runs. A small cleanup for anyone building model pickers or routing requests.

Cost and price calculations now resolve against the actual selected model rather than a mismatched reference. The accounting machinery has been reminded to read the label on the jar.
